name: HEXIS SAS (the Mateu family)
note: HEXIS SAS, adhesive-film manufacturer based in Frontignan (RCS Montpellier 351 372 677), founded in 1989 by Michel Mateu (hexis-graphics.com societe page). France's official companies directory (Recherche d'entreprises, RNE) lists Caroline Mateu as president of the SAS, Clement Mateu as director-general and Michel Mateu as deputy director-general. The French beneficial-owners register has not been public since July 2024; no state body or fund found in the management chain. parentId null.
